scope: One targeted gene; Uhlitz existing matrices plus published author CNA calls
primary_test: Exact two-sided sign test on nonzero patient-paired differences; zeros retained in effect and denominator reporting
effect: Median patient-paired difference; distribution-free order-statistic interval with at least 95% coverage
multiple_testing: BH across all three planned contrasts; unavailable tests use p=1 internally and remain NA publicly
unit: patient; pool samples within same patient and group; never treat cells as independent patients
label_policy: Preserve original CNA/CNN; CNN never renamed nonmalignant; do not derive calls from UCKL1
normal_reference: Author sample_origin Normal, main_cell_type Epithelial, exclude cell_type_epi_custom starting TC as in original infercnv.R
conflicts: Exclude entire donor if author call source_id disagrees with source metadata after exact documented cell-ID join
missing: No imputation; missing cell groups not zero; unknown labels excluded with reasons
selection: Target requested after prior expression review; exploratory targeted follow-up, not prospective validation
